basis: The full-period cooling water temperature change from 2005 to 2014 is calculated as the 2014 value minus the 2005 value: 10.1°C - 23.9°C = -13.8°C. The chart provides no definition, threshold, or policy table for what constitutes a 'substantial change'. The routing criterion requires determining whether this change requires substantial-change follow-up. The public task and page instructions direct the user to use the dashboard to make this determination. Since no explicit threshold or policy basis is supplied, the only supported route is to retain the record in routine monitoring for ordinary variation, as per the condition that substantial-change follow-up may not be selected without an explicit demonstrated threshold or policy basis.
option_label: Keep the 2005 to 2014 cooling water temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation
